replacements.name: typed-owner-inline-y
replacements.text:
draw_pos =
                camera_offset
                + creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->position.x,
                    ((creature_t *)((char *)tint
                        - offsetof(creature_t, color)))->position.y)
                - creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f,
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f);

replacements.name: relative-float-y
replacements.text:
draw_pos =
                camera_offset
                + creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->position.x,
                    ((float *)tint)[
                        (offsetof(creature_t, position)
                            + offsetof(vec2f_t, y)
                            - offsetof(creature_t, color)) / sizeof(float)])
                - creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f,
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f);

replacements.name: relative-byte-y
replacements.text:
draw_pos =
                camera_offset
                + creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->position.x,
                    *(float *)((char *)tint
                        + offsetof(creature_t, position)
                        + offsetof(vec2f_t, y)
                        - offsetof(creature_t, color)))
                - creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f,
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f);

replacements.name: named-relative-float-y
replacements.text:
const float *tint_words = (const float *)tint;
            draw_pos =
                camera_offset
                + creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->position.x,
                    tint_words[(offsetof(creature_t, position)
                        + offsetof(vec2f_t, y)
                        - offsetof(creature_t, color)) / sizeof(float)])
                - creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f,
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f);
